summary.caption: Contemporary botanical thank-you card built from a rich indigo cyanotype garden, translucent pressed flowers and one oversized typographic gesture, balancing scientific detail with tactile handmade printmaking.

items.label: object
items.caption: Full-height cyanotype composition of wild meadow plants, ferns and seed heads exposed as intricate pale-blue silhouettes on saturated indigo handmade paper, fine photographic detail, deckled texture and uneven sun-print edges.

items.label: object
items.caption: Three real translucent pressed flowers laid across the cyanotype, coral, amber and milky white petals casting tiny physical shadows, arranged diagonally with museum-specimen precision.

items.label: text
items.caption: Enormous warm-white italic high-contrast serif words crossing the botanical field, elegant flourishes but clearly readable.
